title: Paper Planes Down
description: Original lo-fi hip-hop instrumental in D minor at 82 BPM: swung, softened drums with rim ghosts, a round low-passed sine bass, mellow triangle electric-keys comping over Dm9-Bbmaj9-Gm9-A7b9, a dark pad and a delayed sine lead for the hooks (synth approximation of Rhodes, bass and flute; no vocals or vinyl samples).
